description: Remove a previously-declared dependency: drop blockerStoryId from storyId's blocked_by array. Idempotent — succeeds even if the blocker isn't present (no audit row in that case). When a state transition actually occurs, emits a story.blocker_removed audit row.

blockerStoryId.description: UUID of the blocker being removed. Idempotent — if the blocker isn't in the array, the call succeeds without emitting an audit row.

storyId.description: UUID of the story whose blocker is being removed (the dependent).

name: remove_blocker
